extracted.name: Red Snapper
extracted.description: Canadian whiskey, amaretto and cranberry juice over ice make for a Northern treat with a 'snappy' red color.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1.5 fluid ounce) jigger deluxe Canadian whiskey
instruction_lines: Fill a tall glass with ice. Pour in the whiskey and amaretto, then fill to the top with cranberry juice. Stir and enjoy.
